titulo: Dinner for one, on a plate
caption:
Dinner for one, on a plate

Dinner for one deserves a plate. It is two minutes of effort and the meal turns from fuel into dinner.

A plate is a tiny decision that says this meal counts, even when nobody else is eating it.

For whoever plates the food even when it is just them.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a pot of food steaming on the right. A brick red block figure with narrowed eyes at the far left says just eat from the pot. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers plate it, walks toward the middle and a plate with a serving of food appears while the steam stops. The red one's eyes go wide and says huh. that's nicer. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me plating it, even for one.
